summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing for Fatima's Spoken English Centre. All 27 backend pytest tests pass (auth, public/admin course CRUD, admin route protection, enrolment validation, complete OTP flow including send/cooldown/wrong-code-reject/verify-creates-enrolment). Frontend flows verified: home course cards, course pre-selection on card Enrol Now click, form validation, OTP step visibility, 45s resend cooldown timer, wrong OTP rejection toast, Edit details returns to form, admin login->dashboard, Courses tab CRUD, Enrolments tab filter/sort, logout, protected route redirect.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / Description (a11y warning in console). Non-blocking but should add DialogDescription.

action_items: Optional: add <DialogDescription> to admin course add/edit and delete-confirm dialogs to remove Radix a11y console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — should migrate to lifespan context manager (FastAPI >=0.109 warns).
verify_otp does not delete otp_codes on max-attempts (5); the record stays until natural expiry — acceptable but slightly wasteful.

CORS uses allow_credentials=True with allow_origins that may default to '*' (from env). If CORS_ORIGINS env is '*', browsers will reject credentialed requests — currently frontend uses Bearer token, not cookies, so not blocking, but flag the config.
phone validator only checks length >=8 digits after stripping; no country code enforcement (spec said 'phone with country code'). Acceptable but weaker validation.
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted TEST_ courses during CRUD tests. UI test accidentally deleted the 'Beginner' seed course (via .last selector) and left a TEST_UI_Course; both restored via API before finishing. DB is back to the 3 default courses.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py is comprehensive (auth, protection, CRUD, validation, full OTP flow reading code from mongo). To avoid deleting seeded courses via UI, use delete-course-{id} with the specific id of your test-created course rather than .last. All data-testids present as spec'd.
